The Workforce Analyst provides data-driven insights that help the organization improve utilization, plan for demand, and make informed resourcing decisions. Coordinates the execution of workforce planning activities based on approved strategies and action plans. Monitors resource allocation across projects and identifies inefficiencies or discrepancies that may impact delivery performance or project profitability; escalates findings to the Workforce Lead/Manager. Consolidates and reviews information related to resources’ performance, skills, and capabilities to support effective workforce allocation decisions. Coordinates with Delivery and Sales by providing capacity and skills visibility needed for project assignments, potential replacements, and upcoming opportunities. Works with TAG (Talent Acquisition Group) by supplying timely demand and supply data, and provides input to help assess whether internal resources or external hiring may be required. Coordinates updates to the workforce database to ensure accuracy of resource availability, skills profiles, competency levels, certifications, and project assignments. Analyzes workforce data (skills trends, patterns, capacity signals) to help identify skills gaps and support the development of capability-building plans. Supports the development and maintenance of a skills library by consolidating data on demand and supply trends across accounts or projects. Account Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile customer accounts to ensure balances are accurate and up to date. Aging Report Management: Maintain and monitor accounts receivable aging reports, following up on overdue accounts and escalating problematic cases as needed. Customer Communication: Build and maintain relationships with customers to resolve billing and payment issues, and negotiate payment plans when necessary. Credit Limits & Terms: Recommend credit limits and payment terms based on company guidelines and credit risk assessment. Dispute Resolution: Work with internal departments (sales, customer service, etc.) to resolve billing disputes and ensure smooth resolution. Reporting: Prepare regular reports on collection efforts, credit issues, and overall account status for management review.
